findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Canonical provider data can remain stale because no live workspace-scoped hourly refresh chain was found.
findings.plan_claim: Server-controlled hourly refresh is the accepted target.
findings.contract_claim: Workspace authority and canonical Dataset V2 are mandatory.
findings.runtime_fact: Legacy runtime uses fixed four-hour platform hours, today refresh, and one daily last_7d recovery.
findings.schema_fact: Observed schedules are user-scoped, inactive, and 240-minute; no canonical workspace schedule/job authority was found.
findings.live_evidence: Five Dataset V2 acceptance rows exist, but none is attributable to a recurring source job.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Single acceptance writes do not prove recurring production refresh.
findings.remediation_dependency: A6 scheduler/job authority package after audit completion.
findings.acceptance_needed: Hourly workspace-scoped lease/job execution, retry, lineage and freshness evidence.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: A displayed fact cannot be traced to the exact provider run or safely reconciled after corrections.
findings.plan_claim: Canonical facts require reproducible provenance and observable jobs.
findings.contract_claim: Raw evidence must be redacted but reproducible.
findings.runtime_fact: Current controlled acceptance writes bypass recurring job lineage.
findings.schema_fact: All five live rows have null source_job_id; raw JSON lacks request/response identity, attribution configuration, observation timestamp and provider revision.
findings.live_evidence: 1 Meta and 4 Klaviyo non-synthetic rows are present without run linkage.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: The data values may be valid, but their production and correction history is not provable.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not relabel existing rows as final solely from their values.
findings.remediation_dependency: Provider run provenance and reconciliation contract.
findings.acceptance_needed: Every new fact links to a durable run/request/revision record; A4 verifies truthful UI status.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Different provider correction windows can be collapsed into an invalid universal finality rule.
findings.plan_claim: E9-T8 requires provider data maturity, reconciliation and finality.
findings.runtime_fact: Legacy policy includes a provider-independent three-hour maturity default.
findings.schema_fact: Dataset V2 has no explicit maturity/finality/provisional/reconciled state.
findings.live_evidence: Klaviyo 2026-10-02 rows are described as provisional outside the row itself.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Provider-specific semantics cannot be represented or enforced by the current live data path.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not introduce one guessed global window.
findings.remediation_dependency: Versioned provider-specific maturity contract before production cutover.
findings.acceptance_needed: Per-provider lookback/finality state with reproducible correction tests.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Interrupted backfill/reconciliation cannot prove safe resume or duplicate avoidance in live operation.
findings.plan_claim: Backfill is resumable, idempotent and measurable.
findings.contract_claim: R8 requires canonical validation/provenance and coverage.
findings.runtime_fact: Workspace checkpoint/idempotent code artefacts exist in the repository.
findings.schema_fact: No physical backfill_checkpoints table was found.
findings.live_evidence: R8 remains blocked and no live workspace checkpoint chain exists.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Repository implementation artefacts are not live operational control.
findings.safe_boundary: Keep R8 blocked; do not copy V1 rows directly.
findings.remediation_dependency: Workspace lease/checkpoint schema and runtime package.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Late provider conversions or adjustments can be missed, causing AdsTable to diverge from provider Ads Manager.
findings.contract_claim: Provider official semantics must govern attribution and correction.
findings.runtime_fact: Legacy runtime refreshes today and performs a daily last_7d recovery.
findings.schema_fact: No provider-specific reconciliation policy is persisted with facts or runs.
findings.live_evidence: Current rows do not record which lookback or attribution rule produced them.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: A seven-day catch-up is not a complete universal provider finality policy.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not expand history blindly every hour before quota/cost and provider-specific rules are contracted.
findings.acceptance_needed: Correction fixtures and live reconciliation evidence for each active provider.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Stakeholders can mistake connection, verified-empty response, first write and recurring completeness as the same PASS.
findings.plan_claim: Done/PASS requires all applicable acceptance and evidence conditions.
findings.contract_claim: Each claim is classified across plan, contract, runtime, schema and live evidence.
findings.runtime_fact: Provider acceptance was performed through several different controlled paths.
findings.schema_fact: Live data does not encode the acceptance stage.
findings.live_evidence: Meta non-empty, Google verified-empty and Klaviyo provisional non-empty evidence are materially different.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Status language is not yet consistently split by acceptance layer.
findings.safe_boundary: Preserve current open/pending statements; do not downgrade valid evidence.
findings.acceptance_needed: Four distinct gates per provider: capability/raw, hierarchy/mapping, first canonical write, recurring reconciliation/finality.
